correctness.rationale: The reproducible finite certificate constructs the full scale-two 196-face complex twice, has two completely verified 96-pair acyclic matchings with four critical two-cells, and checks all 588 incidences. Every one of 48 automorphisms is checked; the Lefschetz formula yields a 1-dimensional trivial character and 3-dimensional central-odd character of self-inner-product 1. An independent mod-two chain-rank calculation corroborates the Betti number.
